effect.essentialcraft5.radiation.desc.en: Hoanna's radiation builds up in your body: every 10,000 dose is one level. From level II on, every so often your health is forced down to a cap; the higher the level, the lower the cap and the more often it happens.
effect.essentialcraft5.radiation.desc.zh: 海纳尔的辐射积在体内，每满一万剂量升一级。从 II 级起，生命会时不时被压到上限，级数越高，上限越低、压得越勤。

effect.essentialcraft5.radiation.footer.en: Radiation in your body: milk, totems and cleansing cannot remove it, and death does not reset it. It fades slowly once you leave Hoanna; a λ ring speeds that up.
effect.essentialcraft5.radiation.footer.zh: 积在体内的辐射：牛奶、图腾、净化都去不掉，死亡也不会清空。离开海纳尔才慢慢消退，λ 指环能让它退得快些。
